correctness.rationale: PASS: The free A4 action follows because every nonidentity even color permutation has exactly two color orbits, whose invariant color sets would improperly 2-color C5. The published Hom(C5,K4)=RP3 result supplies a closed 3-manifold with universal S3 covering. The packaged exact verifier constructs 2160 cells, 180 quotient cells, signed integral boundary matrices with zero boundary squares, and Smith factors 1^19;1^45,3;1^24; thus H1=C3, H2=0, H3=Z. The central order-24 covering extension has derived subgroup Q8 and quotient C3, hence pi1=Q8 semidirect C3=SL2(F3).

Its binary tetrahedral pi1 and exact 3-torsion distinguish it from previously computed source-dihedral quotients and from the rational-character invariant that cannot see such extensions.
